# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `oddbout` MCP server pointing at ODDBOUT's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.oddbout.com/mcp`).
- Public reads need no sign-in; account features use Google OAuth.
- Logo: ODDBOUT's site favicon (SVG).
